2609.35115.title: DuplexCadence: Exact State and Execution from a Speech Model's Declared Timelines
2609.35115.paper_summary: Full-duplex speech models support streaming interaction that listens and speaks at the same time. Serving them is governed by a strict, repeating deadline: conversation advances on a one-second cadence, and every second of input must be turned into a second of speech before the next second arrives. Because stages within a session run in strict sequence, per-invocation overhead cannot be batched away. Profiling reveals that the autoregressive stages of a duplex second already fit within the period, whereas the token-to-audio synthesis tail is what causes overruns. This tail stage suffers from orchestration slack where the GPU is left waiting as thousands of tiny, regular operations are issued one by one, while also wasting substantial memory by over-provisioning state at static implementation constants. Existing remedies, such as graph recording and demand-sized allocation, fail because streaming state dynamics violate their prerequisites. The root cause is that the runtime lacks the model's native clocks: the per-region counters that govern advancement rates and retention policies. We propose DuplexCadence, which explicitly declares native clocks to the runtime and derives two mutually enabling rules: demand-sized state allocation at a stable address, and exact-shape graph replay without padding. The former eliminates idle memory and stabilizes tensor pointers, while the latter removes orchestration slack without padding overhead. Evaluated on four released models across three decoder architectures with bit-for-bit identical output, DuplexCadence reaches $2.85\times$ the stock runtime's speed at $38.8\%$ lower peak memory. 2609.35115.paper_summary_zh: 全雙工語音模型支持同時聆聽和說話的串流互動。其服務受到嚴格且重複的截止時間的約束：對話以每秒一次的節奏推進，每秒的輸入必須在下一秒到來之前轉換為一秒的語音。由於會話中的階段以嚴格的順序運行，因此每次調用的開銷無法批量處理。分析顯示，雙工第二階段的自回歸階段已經適合這個時間段，而從標記到音頻的合成尾部則是導致超時的原因。這個尾部階段受到協調空閒的影響，因為GPU在數千個小且常規的操作一個接一個地發出時被迫等待，同時還因為在靜態實現常數上過度配置狀態而浪費了大量內存。現有的補救措施，如圖形記錄和需求大小分配，失敗了，因為串流狀態動態違反了它們的前提條件。根本原因在於運行時缺乏模型的原生時鐘：控制推進速率和保留策略的每個區域計數器。我們提出了DuplexCadence，它明確地向運行時聲明原生時鐘並推導出兩條相互促進的規則：在穩定地址上的需求大小狀態分配，以及無填充的精確形狀圖形重播。前者消除了閒置內存並穩定了張量指針，而後者在不增加填充開銷的情況下消除了協調空閒。在三種解碼器架構上對四個已發布模型進行評估，輸出逐位相同，DuplexCadence達到了標準運行時速度的$2.85\times$，同時峰值內存降低了$38.8\%$。在實時雙工路徑上，平均SPEAK時間從超過一秒節奏的$14\%$降至其下的$2\%$，使模型能夠可靠地跟上互動語音，同時顯著擴展多-
